messages.subject: Tweaking app after deploying
parts:
Hey,

I've just deployed my first app! Everything went super smooth. http://cijoe.shinyapps.io/foiDub (if you're interested; comments/suggestions welcome).

After viewing it on a couple of different browsers and different size screens I want to make a couple of minor cosmetic changes here and there, and I was wondering about the best way to go about this. Is it possible to tweak while deployed? or should I suspend, tweak and redeploy? If the latter, how do you suspend the app.

Thanks.

K.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Tweaking app after deploying
parts:
Thank you for the kind words Killian.  To answer your question, you should simply deploy the app again when you have made your changes locally and have it working there.  The service will take care of bringing up another instance of the app, and shutting down the old one.   
-Tareef
